rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a scarf worn around the neck.

example.english: It's cold today, so I put on a scarf before going out.
example.traditional: 今日凍，我戴咗條頸巾先出街。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 dung3 ngo5 daai3 zo2 tiu4 geng2 gan1 sin1 ceot1 gaai1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a cloth or scarf worn over the head rather than around the neck.

example.english: Mum wears a scarf over her head when she goes to the market.
example.traditional: 阿媽去街市嗰陣會戴住條頭巾。
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 heoi3 gaai1 si5 go2 zan6 wui5 daai3 zyu6 tiu4 tau4 gan1
